title: feat(app-shell): register record:approval_decision, armed in @object-ui/types (objectui#12342)
body:
Fixes #12342
Clause-②: yes

## What

`@objectstack/spec` 18 declares the page block `record:approval_decision`. `ApprovalDecisionRenderer` existed, but no registration mounted it, so a page naming the block passed the spec and drew nothing. This PR registers it and lands everything a registered, page-authorable type needs in this repo.

- **Registration (`@object-ui/app-shell`).** New side-effect leaf `views/record-approval-decision-renderer.tsx` registers `ApprovalDecisionRenderer` as `record:approval_decision` (namespace `record`, `skipFallback: true`, so no bare `approval_decision`). It joins the entry's side-effect imports and both halves of the package `sideEffects` array, the same path `record:approvals` and `record:attachments` take. The renderer itself is unchanged and still not exported from the entry.
- **Arm (`@object-ui/types`).** New `RecordApprovalDecisionBlockSchema` (zod, `zod/record-approval-decision.zod.ts`) plus a TS twin of the same name (`record-approval-decision.ts`), and a new member of `AnyComponentSchema` (zod and TS). The `properties` bag restates the spec row: the spec builds it inline as an empty strict object and exports it under no name, the same situation as `element:divider`. So the only bag it accepts is `{}`. `body` / `children` are refused by name.
- **CLI.** `known-schema-types.ts` regenerated (`node scripts/regenerate-known-schema-types.mjs`): plus `record:approval_decision`.
- **Studio palette.** Not offered (card ruling). Only the `PALETTE_EXCLUSIONS` reason changed, from "not yet registered" to "renders (registered by `@object-ui/app-shell`), not yet offered".
- Docs: an app-shell README section for the block. Changeset: `.changeset/12342-register-approval-decision.md` (app-shell and types minor, cli patch).

## Why it lands outside app-shell too

The card read this as registration plus pins. Measurement showed that registration alone would raise a ratchet pin that must never rise. `registered-types-validate-ratchet-10859` (`@object-ui/cli`) counts registered namespaced types that `objectui validate` refuses at `type`. On `main`, `validateAuthoredDocument` answers `invalid_union` at `type` for `record:approval_decision`, and also for `record:approvals` and `record:attachments` (probe run on base `065a1cf`). Registering the block without an arm would take `NAMESPACED_REFUSED_AT_TYPE` from 308 to 309. The panel's own docblock already planned for the registration, its side-effect import, its `known-schema-types.ts` line and its zod arm to land together. The arm follows the `cloud:` widgets' precedent (its own module, wired into `AnyComponentSchema`, TS twin plus mirror-parity pair). It is not in `public-blocks.zod.ts`, because that union is pinned to the ADR-0080 curated list and this block is not curated.

## Premise checks (dispatch section 2)

- **A1 holds.** The renderer is at `views/approval-decision/ApprovalDecisionPanel.tsx`, and its test pinned `ComponentRegistry.has('record:approval_decision') === false`. The pin is flipped to `true` plus `get(...) === ApprovalDecisionRenderer`, and a new row renders `{ type: 'record:approval_decision' }` through the real `SchemaRenderer`.
- **A2 holds for the path, but not for the arm.** Same registration path and `sideEffects` handling as the two siblings (`check:side-effects-array` green). The siblings are registered without arms, so copying them exactly is what the ratchet refuses (see above).
- **A3: no double render.** `RecordDetailView` only skips `useRecordApprovals` on a `sys_approval_request` page, and its comment names this block as the place where decisions are drawn. It mounts no panel by any route of its own; the panel appears only where page metadata places the block. `RecordDetailView.tsx` is not edited, so this PR has no interaction with #12356.
- **A4 holds.** The installed `@objectstack/spec` 18.0.0-next.0 carries `ComponentPropsMap['record:approval_decision']` as `emptyProps(...)`, a strict object with no member. The new arm test re-reads that row on every run: its key set is empty, and the arm's bag accepts and refuses exactly what the row does.

## Pins on a real render

`apps/console/src/services/approvalRequestsDataSource.decisionPage.test.tsx` (real `RecordDetailView`, real `DeclaredActionsBar`, routed approvals source):
- This file used to register the renderer itself. That registration is removed, and a row asserts the package's registration is what the page reaches.
- New: **a decided request** (status `approved`, no tally, `can_act: false`) gets the panel with no progress bar and no decision. **A viewer who may not decide** (the submitter, pending) gets the tally and the recall control, and no approve or reject. **CONTROL:** the deciding viewer gets both decisions and no recall. The pending-request rows already present still pass.

## Verification (final head `e7e004c`)

- vitest, one run on `e7e004c` under the verify lock: `packages/types/` + `packages/cli/` in full, `packages/app-shell/src/views/approval-decision/`, `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/__tests__/`, the product-neutral ratchet, the two console files, `scripts/__tests__/known-schema-types-derivation-5115.test.ts` -- `Test Files 427 passed (427)`, `Tests 11161 passed (11161)`.
- type-check: `@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/cli` all exit 0 on `3a9b5d5`, after building their dependency closure (`--filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' --filter '@object-ui/cli^...'`). `@object-ui/types` was re-run on `e7e004c` and exits 0. The only change from `3a9b5d5` to `e7e004c` is one string literal in the arm's refusal text. The app-shell `tsconfig.test.json` covers `src/**/*.test.tsx`, so the uncast `SchemaRenderer` row is type-checked against the built `@object-ui/types`.
- **Ablation 1 (registration):** removing the barrel import in `packages/app-shell/src/index.ts` through `ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 to 0, blob changed) turns the console file red: `Tests 7 failed | 4 passed (11)`, starting with the registration row. Restore was proven by blob == HEAD.
- **Ablation 2 (decided-case non-vacuity):** flipping the decided row's `can_act` to `true` turns `a decided request` red (`expected button to be null`). Restore was proven by blob == HEAD.
- Gates, each exit code read directly on `e7e004c`: `check:phantom-deps`, `self-import`, `unreferenced-sources`, `doc-example-readers`, `handler-key-reads`, `side-effects-array`, `element-data-source-declaration`, `spec-symbols`, `action-forward-parity`, `designer-field-key-parity`, `icon-record-names`, `i18n-keys`, `i18n-drift`, `i18n-designer-parity`, `registry-bare-names`, `control-bytes`, `new-line-citations` all 0. `check-changeset-fixed.mjs`, `check-changeset-presence.mjs` and `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` are 0. `check:sdui-registration-pins` is 0 after a full console build (`approval_decision 1 chunk(s)`, 16 of 16 present; measured on `3a9b5d5`, and `e7e004c` changes no registration or array). `check:spec-floors` is 1, with "The scan collapsed: 0 package(s) declare @objectstack/spec in a consumer-facing field". That is the known failure on `main` (objectui#12334), and this diff touches no dependency field.
- **Lint, narrowed:** `eslint --format json` over the 17 changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files gives 17 results, 0 errors and 0 warnings. The package `lint` scripts are `eslint .` (types, app-shell, console) and `eslint src` (cli). `eslint.config.js` sets no `project` / `projectService`, so linting is not type-aware and this diff cannot change the verdict on any untouched file. The full `pnpm lint` run belongs to CI.

## Acceptance notes

- **Accept set and exports widen (the dispatch declared `Clause-②: no`):** `@object-ui/types/zod` exports `RecordApprovalDecisionBlockSchema`, `@object-ui/types` exports the TS type of the same name, and `AnyComponentSchema` / `StrictAnyComponentSchema` / `objectui validate` now accept a `record:approval_decision` node. All three follow from the spec row. They are reported here and in the dev report; no `Clause-②` line is written.
- The arm does not spread `NODE_ENVELOPE` (`responsiveStyles`). Like the `cloud:` arms, it declares no node-level key without a measured producer, and Studio does not offer the block.
- `record:approvals` and `record:attachments` remain registered without arms. `objectui validate` still refuses both at `type` while the spec accepts them, and they stay inside the namespaced ratchet count. Not addressed here; noted in the dev report.
